It's a high-stakes game that can pay off big time -- one featured collector bought a unit for $800 and sold its contents for a $40,000 profit -- or leave one sifting through the equivalent of trash.

programme.title: Woman on the Run (1950)
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist (1953)
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

She takes a job as a waitress and keeps a low profile, but she is soon won over by the warmth and caring of the close-knit community, especially that of Alex, a widower. With the help of Alex and his children, Katie learns to love and trust again, but when a mysterious stranger arrives and starts asking questions, Katie's dark past threatens to reclaim her.

programme.title: Blue Valentine (2010)
programme.desc: Dean (Ryan Gosling) and Cindy (Michelle Williams) live a quiet life in a modest neighborhood. To the casual observer, everything appears normal, if a bit subdued. But a closer examination reveals a couple caught in a downward spiral. They appear to have the world at their feet at the outset of the relationship. However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage.

programme.title: Family Feud Favorites
programme.desc: "Family Feud" has seen some crazy moments over the years, so buckle up as we revisit these fan favorites. This fast-paced clip show delivers the funniest, most viral and most unforgettable highlights from America's favorite game show. From hilariously wrong answers to Steve Harvey's one-of-a kind reactions, "Family Feud Favorites" captures the best moments that fans can't stop talking about.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: In this original version of iconic game show "Family Feud," actor Richard Dawson plays host to two teams, each comprised of five family members, who try to match the answers given to survey questions asked to groups of people (typically 100 people in the group). The family that wins the game by being the first to reach a certain point total, either 200 or 300 depending on the rules at the time, advances to the bonus round, called Fast Money, for a chance to win thousands of dollars by answering more survey questions.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

programme.title: Jericho (2000)
programme.desc: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho.

programme.title: Boss (1975)
programme.desc: Two ex-slave bounty hunters (Fred Williamson, D'Urville Martin) take care of business in a lawless Wild West town.

programme.title: West of the Divide (1934)
programme.desc: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it.

programme.title: Range Beyond the Blue (1947)
programme.desc: A stagecoach operator in the untamed territories of the American Southwest, Margie Rodgers (Helen Mowery) becomes a target for bandits when she starts hauling gold. Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail (1933)
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

programme.title: Frontier Fugitives (1945)
programme.desc: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

programme.title: Ambush Trail (1946)
programme.desc: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid (1946)
programme.desc: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. He rides into the town where the murder took place, but there Sheriff Landon (Edward Cassidy) warns him against vigilantism. This doesn't stop Tom from pursuing poker player Honest John (I. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: Yankee Fakir (1947)
programme.desc: Yankee Davis (Douglas Fowley) and his partner, professor Newton (Ransom Sherman), are a pair of traveling hucksters on their way to a town in Arizona. Soon after they arrive, Yankee falls for a local girl, Mary Mason (Joan Woodbury). Mary's lawman father turns up dead, and Yankee is sure the man was murdered, but the death is ruled an accident. Believing something's off, Yankee has an elderly associate, Shaggy (Clem Bevans), pose as a rich man and offer a reward for clues about the killing.

Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: The Star Packer (1934)

Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

programme.desc: While Andy's mother is admitted to a psychiatric hospital, the young boy is placed in foster care, and Chucky, determined to claim Andy's soul, is not far behind.","large":"Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. programme.title: Child's Play 3 (???)
programme.desc: Chucky returns for revenge against Andy, the young boy who defeated him, and now a teenager living in a military academy.","large":"It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky (???)
programme.desc: Animated by a vicious killer's spirit, a battered doll and its mate seek help from neighbors (Katherine Heigl, Nick Stabile) to regain human form.","large":"After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter (2022)
programme.desc: Quasifederal agents hunt a man (David Keith), who can bend minds, and his daughter (Drew Barrymore), who can start fires by staring.","large":"As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop.".

programme.title: The Thing (???)
programme.desc: An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World."","large":"In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman (???)
programme.desc: An acid-scarred scientist (Liam Neeson) uses 99-minute masks to be with his girlfriend (Frances McDormand) and trap gangsters.","large":"When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors (???)
programme.desc: Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.","large":"Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred (???)

programme.title: Howard the Duck (???)
programme.desc: George Lucas' tale of an extraterrestrial duck who is mistakenly brought to Cleveland by an experimental laser beam.","large":"In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes (???)
programme.desc: A nursing-home resident (Jessica Tandy) regales a visitor (Kathy Bates) with tales of the close friendship between two women in the 1930s Alabama.","large":"On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. programme.title: Sisters (2015)

programme.desc: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

It seems someone at a touring rodeo show is killing the top riders before they can take home the trophy -- and the prize money. Weston agrees to investigate and works his way into the show, which is run by the shady Spike Barton (Edward Peil). As Weston gets closer to the truth, he finds himself in even greater danger.

As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: Corrupt Crimes
programme.desc: True-crime series are a staple of the TV landscape. "Corrupt Crimes" analyzes recent criminal cases through a combination of expert testimony and dramatic storytelling. From crimes like doping in sports to more serious offenses like murder, the series exposes what is really going on in each case. Exposing corruption across the United States is the goal of the series. Cases featured in the half-hour episodes include an ATM heist that resulted in nearly $45 million being stolen worldwide and the former Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick.

programme.title: Jack Goes Boating (2010)
programme.desc: Single Jack (Philip Seymour Hoffman) drives a limo for a living and has a best friend, Clyde (John Ortiz), a married co-worker. Clyde and his wife decide to set up Jack with another friend, Connie (Amy Ryan). Jack and Connie hit it off, and a tentative romance blossoms, inspiring Jack to take cooking lessons, learn to swim, and apply for his dream job. However, as that relationship grows stronger, Clyde and his wife find their marriage crumbling.

Upon arrival, Wilson goes to task battling Valentine (Peter Fonda) and an army of L.A.'s toughest criminals, hoping to find clues and piece together what happened. After surviving a near-death beating, getting thrown from a building and being chased down a dangerous mountain road, the Englishman decides to dole out some bodily harm of his own.

programme.title: Jericho (2000)
programme.desc: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho.

programme.title: West of the Divide (1934)
programme.desc: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it.

programme.title: Range Beyond the Blue (1947)
programme.desc: A stagecoach operator in the untamed territories of the American Southwest, Margie Rodgers (Helen Mowery) becomes a target for bandits when she starts hauling gold. Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail (1933)
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

programme.title: Frontier Fugitives (1945)
programme.desc: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

programme.title: Ambush Trail (1946)

Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid (1946)

Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: Trees Lounge (1996)
programme.desc: Long Island loser Tommy (Steve Buscemi) is a hopeless alcoholic who loses his job for stealing from his boss, Rob (Anthony LaPaglia), who's now dating his ex, Theresa (Elizabeth Bracco). Tommy copes with his failures by hanging out at local dive Trees Lounge with friends he can barely stand. He takes a gig as the ice cream man, but he's awful with kids. programme.title: Stars Over Texas (1946)
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). programme.title: In Old Amarillo (1951)
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: Border Feud (1947)
programme.desc: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon (1935)
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: West to Glory (1947)
programme.desc: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), an undercover U.S. agent, is sent to a Mexican border town to protect the valuable Lopez diamond. One day he and his friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) attend a party thrown by Don Lopez (Harry Vejar), a wealthy prospector who also holds large reserves of gold. After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men.

programme.title: Black Hills (1947)
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: The Star Packer (1934)
programme.desc: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

Clash after deadly clash wears down the morale and readiness of Clemons' men, and when they ask for back up, command is neither willing to send reinforcements nor authorize a retreat.

programme.desc: Rosalie (Anne Bancroft) is the sister of notorious, well-connected mobster Phil (Anthony Quinn). programme.desc: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. programme.title: Sugar Hill (1974)
programme.desc: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers.

programme.title: Blacula (1972)
programme.desc: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail.

programme.title: Scream Blacula Scream (1973)
programme.desc: When a hated rival, Lisa Fortier (Pam Grier), is chosen to lead the voodoo cult of Willis Daniels' (Richard Lawson) late mother, a vengeful Willis brings the doomed vampire Prince Mamuwalde (William Marshall) back to life. Willis soon finds the vampire too powerful to control, and Lisa agrees to perform a spell that will break the curse placed on the prince. But, when racist sheriff Dunlop (Michael Conrad) gets involved, the vampire unleashes his deadly revenge.

programme.title: Black Mama, White Mama (1972)
programme.desc: Lee Daniels (Pam Grier) is a black girl busted for prostitution. Karen Brent (Margaret Markov) is a white girl arrested for her involvement with a local revolutionary group. The two women meet in jail and, despite their mutual animosity, are chained together for transport to a maximum security prison. Their bus is ambushed en route, however, and the pair manages to escape together. Chased by bounty hunters, crooked police and revolutionaries, they struggle to get along and get away.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones (1986)

programme.title: Hickey & Boggs (1972)
programme.desc: Two Los Angeles private eyes (Bill Cosby, Robert Culp) find a missing woman and follow her to loot from a Pittsburgh bank.

programme.title: Odds Against Tomorrow (1959)
programme.desc: Disgraced former police officer David Burke (Ed Begley) is looking for a way to make some quick money. When he decides to rob a bank, he calls on mean ex-con Earle Slater (Robert Ryan) and black entertainer Johnny Ingram (Harry Belafonte) to help him pull off the heist. Johnny is reluctant to agree but is forced to reconsider because of his significant gambling debts, while racist Earle balks because of Johnny's involvement. Ultimately, though, they must work together to get the job done.

programme.title: Paris Blues (1961)
programme.desc: Despite being far from home, American jazz musicians Ram Bowen (Paul Newman) and Eddie Cook (Sidney Poitier) are content living and working in Paris. Ram knows it's the best place for him to develop his musical reputation, and Eddie is far away from the racism that once greeted him on a regular basis. But after meeting and falling in love with American tourists Lillian (Joanne Woodward) and Connie (Diahann Carroll), the pair must decide whether their artistic integrity is worth abandoning.

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs! (1970)
programme.desc: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children.

programme.title: The Organization (1971)
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy (1975)
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: Pressure Point (1962)
programme.desc: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment.

programme.desc: After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). programme.title: Drango (1957)

Marc Banning along, he faces a distrustful town, as well as former Confederates led by the manipulative Clay Allen. A high-stakes battle of wills ensues as Drango, who hides a dark secret related to the town, must win the people's support to prevent the Union Army from intervening.

Although Simon eventually forges a peace agreement with the Sioux, a final battle with Trench looms on the horizon.

programme.desc: Five criminals are recruited by the Confederacy for a dangerous mission in exchange for a pardon. The men -- John Morgan Candy (Bob Campbell), William Parcel Candy (Jonathan Haze), J.C. Haggard (Paul Birch), Hale Clinton (Touch Connors) and Govern Sturges (John Lund) -- are to travel to Kansas to intercept a stagecoach carrying Confederate traitor and spy Stephen Jethro (Jack Ingram) and gold. programme.title: Hot Stove ᴸⁱᵛᵉ
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.

programme.title: Cash Cab
programme.desc: In this offbeat game show, players picked up in the Cash Cab have to answer trivia questions with mounting cash values before they reach their destination in order to win. If a player answers incorrectly three times, he is kicked out of the cab without any money. Help options include a Mobile Shout-Out (phone call) and Street Shout-Out (asking a stranger on the street). Once the player reaches his destination, he can leave the cab with his winnings, if any, or risk them on a more difficult question. A correct final answer doubles his winnings; an incorrect answer means he leaves the cab with no money at all. Comic Ben Bailey takes the cab's wheel as host.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew · S5 E3 Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast · S5 E6 Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza · S5 E7 Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice · S5 E9 Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg · S5 E10 Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: The Best Fish You're Not Eating · S6 E1 Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce · S6 E2 Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

programme.desc: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration. He watches gleefully from his perch on the mountain above, sure that when the Whos awake and see that their holiday decorations, gifts and feast are gone, they will be sad. To his surprise, the Whos celebrate anyway, leading to an unexpected response from the Grinch.

Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown.

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration. He watches gleefully from his perch on the mountain above, sure that when the Whos awake and see that their holiday decorations, gifts and feast are gone, they will be sad. To his surprise, the Whos celebrate anyway, leading to an unexpected response from the Grinch.

programme.title: DuckTales
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck is back in this reboot of the late-'80s animated series. He gains guardianship of grandnephews Huey, Dewey and Louie when Donald Duck reluctantly takes them to McDuck Manor, the wonder of which enthralls the mischievous triplets. While living with their trillionaire relative, the boys learn long-held family secrets and unleash symbolic artifacts from Scrooge's past. The threesome's antics send the family on a number of adventures, which include Webby Vanderquack, the granddaughter of Scrooge's housekeeper, Mrs. Beakley. The show's animation style is inspired by the classic comic designs of animator Carl Barks.

programme.desc: Marinette seems to be a normal teenage girl -- she dreams of becoming a fashion designer, is a bit awkward and has a crush on a classmate. programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it.

programme.desc: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives.

In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives.

programme.desc: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. Dr. Elizabeth Austin, a forensic meteorologist who has worked on countless cases in which weather and crime go hand in hand plays a part in the series.

programme.title: Jamie's Family Christmas
programme.desc: S1 E3 Roasties With the Mosties It's all about roasties with the mosties as Jamie is joined by Gennaro Contaldo, to show how to make the very best roast potatoes and exciting Christmas vegetables; plus lovely leftover recipes. programme.title: Jamie's Family Christmas
programme.desc: S1 E4 Just Desserts Jamie prepares some exciting alternatives to traditional Christmas desserts. Jamie's Winter Pudding Bombe is a Christmas take on summer pudding, with panettone, ice cream, crystallised fruit and sherry. Just bang it in the freezer and hey presto.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible (1996)
programme.desc: Fallout Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster of epic proportions. Arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles plan to use three plutonium cores for a simultaneous nuclear attack on the Vatican, Jerusalem and Mecca. When the weapons go missing, Ethan and his crew find themselves in a desperate race against time to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible (1996)
programme.desc: The Final Reckoning IMF agent Ethan Hunt is in exile with both halves of the 3D cruciform key that can unlock the source code of rogue AI creation, the Entity. Hunt returns to London to reunite with Luther Stickell, Benji Dunn and former thief Grace. The Entity's human henchman, Gabriel, is still on the loose, so Hunt bolsters his ranks with vengeful French assassin Paris and US intelligence agent Theo Degas. Action thriller, starring Tom Cruise, Hayley Atwell, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Esai Morales.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible (1996)
programme.desc: Secret agents suspect there is a traitor in their organisation when their latest assignment ends in disaster. The sole survivor is accused of being the mole, forcing him to go on the run to clear his name. However, in the process, he discovers a former Russian spy is selling information about the world's leading undercover operatives. Action thriller based on the 1960s TV series, starring Tom Cruise, Jon Voight and Ving Rhames.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible 2 (???)
programme.desc: Secret agent Ethan Hunt is sent to find and destroy the only sample of a deadly man-made virus. However, he faces tough opposition in a former spy-turned-criminal mastermind who has already acquired the cure and now wants the pathogen itself. Director John Woo's action thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Dougray Scott, Thandiwe Newton and Anthony Hopkins.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III (2006)
programme.desc: Former secret agent Ethan Hunt is called out of retirement when an ex-trainee is taken hostage by a ruthless arms dealer, but when the rescue operation goes wrong, the villain decides to target Hunt's fiancee. Action thriller sequel directed by JJ Abrams, starring Tom Cruise, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Michelle Monaghan, Ving Rhames and Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible (1996)
programme.desc: Ghost Protocol Secret agent Ethan Hunt and his team are implicated in a bombing at the Kremlin, forcing the American president to declare them fugitives. The spies plan to clear their name by abducting the real terrorist, which leads them into a pursuit around the globe. However, Hunt cannot be sure his colleagues are trustworthy. Action adventure sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Simon Pegg and Paula Patton.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible (1996)
programme.desc: Rogue Nation The team of secret agents faces being shut down when the head of the CIA convinces the US Senate that it is too dangerous. The operatives of the Impossible Mission Force become fugitives when they defy orders and plot to bring down a shadowy society of assassins. Spy thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Rebecca Ferguson and Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Harry Potter e o Prisioneiro de Azkaban (???)
programme.desc: É o terceiro ano de Harry em Hogwarts e ele não só tem um novo professor de "Defesa contra as Artes das Trevas", como problemas para resolver. O homicida condenado Sirius Black escapou da prisão dos feiticeiros e vem atrás de Harry.

programme.title: Homem em Fúria (???)
programme.desc: Com um passado criminoso de mercenário ligado à CIA, um homem é contratado para proteger a vida da filha de 9 anos de um industrial.

programme.title: Kong: Ilha Da Caveira (???)
programme.desc: Uma recriação da origem do mítico Kong, onde uma equipa de cientistas explora uma ilha desconhecida do Pacífico - com tanto de encantadora como de traiçoeira - alheios ao facto de estarem a entrar no território do gorila gigante.

programme.title: Land of Bad (???)
programme.desc: Uma equipa da Força Delta luta pela sobrevivência enquanto um piloto de drone da Força Aérea torna-se os olhos da equipa no ar.

programme.title: Resgate Bilionário (???)
programme.desc: Os estudantes de um reformatório para miúdos ricos e rebeldes decidem defender-se pelos seus próprios meios, quando as instalações da escola são tomadas por um grupo de criminosos.

programme.title: Hellboy e o Homem Torto (???)
programme.desc: Hellboy e um agente novato do BPDP na década de 1950 são enviados para os Apalaches, onde descobrem uma comunidade remota dominada por bruxas e liderada pelo sinistro demônio local, o Crooked Man.

programme.title: Zoom in
programme.desc: S12 E85 Um olhar pelos bastidores dos filmes de maior sucesso de Hollywood.

programme.title: Medieval (???)
programme.desc: A história do ícone tcheco do século XV e senhor da guerra, Jan Zizka, que derrotou os exércitos da Ordem Teutônica e do Sacro Império Romano.

programme.title: Pinóquio (2019)
programme.desc: Nesta nova versão do clássico, Gepetto é um velho carpinteiro que cria uma marioneta e vê algo mágico acontecer: ela ganha vida, começa a falar, a andar, a comer e a correr como qualquer criança. Geppetto chama-o de Pinóquio e cria-o como seu filho.

programme.title: Sing 2 (VP) (???)
programme.desc: Buster Moon e seus amigos devem persuadir o recluso astro do rock Clay Calloway a se juntar a eles para a abertura de um novo show.

programme.title: Super Mario Bros. o Filme (VP) (???)
programme.desc: Os encanadores do Brooklyn, Mario e Luigi, são enviados para o mágico Reino do Cogumelo, e Mario deve se juntar à Princesa Peach, Toad e Donkey Kong para salvar Luigi do malvado Bowser.

programme.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods (2023)
programme.desc: O filme continua a história do adolescente Billy Batson que, ao recitar a palavra mágica "SHAZAM!", é transformado em seu alter ego de super-herói adulto, Shazam.

programme.title: Harry Potter e o Cálice de Fogo (???)
programme.desc: Um jovem feiticeiro compete num torneio perigoso entre escolas rivais de magia, mas vê-se assolado por pesadelos recorrentes.

programme.title: Supremacia (???)
programme.desc: Bourne abandonou a vida de assassino da CIA e tem vivido, com Marie, uma vida no anonimato. No entanto, quando a localização dos dois é descoberta, Bourne vai ter de lutar pela sobrevivência do casal.

programme.title: Taken (???)
programme.desc: A Vingança Quando Mills descobre que sua ex-mulher está a divorciar-se, decide convidá-la, bem como a Kim, para se juntar a ele em Istambul, no que promete ser um fim de semana perfeito para reconquistá-la. Mas, quando Bryan e Lenore são raptados, a filha Kim consegue escapar e a perseguição começa.

programme.title: Bullet Train: Comboio Bala (???)
programme.desc: Cinco assassinos a bordo de um comboio bala em movimento, rápido descobrem que suas missões têm algo em comum.

programme.title: Perseguição (???)
programme.desc: A futura ex-mulher de Will desaparece misteriosamente numa estação de serviço. Ele mergulha no submundo do crime da cidade enquanto foge das autoridades numa corrida contra o tempo para encontrá-la.

programme.title: The Painter (???)
programme.desc: Um ex-agente da CIA é lançado de volta a um mundo perigoso quando uma mulher misteriosa de seu passado ressurge. Agora exposto e alvo de um assassino implacável e de um programa de operações secretas desonesto, ele deve confiar em habilidades que achava ter deixado para trás.

programme.title: Doom (???)
programme.desc: Sobrevivência · - Marines do espaço são enviados para investigar estranhas ocorrências que se verificaram numas instalações de pesquisa em Marte. Mas o grupo acaba por ficar à mercê de avançadas máquinas de matar, geneticamente modificadas.

programme.title: Vingança Súbita (???)
programme.desc: Ao saber da morte de seu irmão, Shannon retorna ao seu antigo reduto para encontrar os homens responsáveis e fazer justiça com as próprias mãos.

programme.title: Super Mario Bros. o Filme (???)
programme.desc: Os encanadores do Brooklyn, Mario e Luigi, são enviados para o mágico Reino do Cogumelo, e Mario deve se juntar à Princesa Peach, Toad e Donkey Kong para salvar Luigi do malvado Bowser.

programme.title: O Lobo e o Leão (???)
programme.desc: Um lobo e uma cria de leão perdidos são salvos por uma rapariga no coração da selva canadiana. A sua amizade irá mudar as suas vidas para sempre.

programme.title: Lassie de Volta a Casa (???)
programme.desc: 30 01:27:00 Florian e a sua cadela, Lassie, são inseparáveis. Mas quando a família se muda para um apartamento pequeno, Florian tem de a entregar ao cuidado do conde Von Sprengel. Lassie acaba por fugir e inicia uma viagem cheia de aventuras à procura do dono.

programme.title: Alvin e os Esquilos 3: Naufragados (???)
programme.desc: Dave arrisca levar Alvin, Simon, Theodore e as Esquiletes de férias, num cruzeiro. Os problemas (re)começam quando decidem abandonar o barco e ficam encalhados numa ilha aparentemente deserta...

programme.title: Shrek para Sempre! (???)
programme.desc: As saudades dos dias em que era um «verdadeiro ogre» levam Shrek a assinar um contrato para reaver o seu temível rugido. Mas, num ápice, o mundo de Shrek vira-se ao contrário. Agora, ele tem apenas 24 horas para recuperar a felicidade.

programme.title: Harry Potter e a Ordem da Fénix (???)
programme.desc: Harry Potter and The Order Of The Phoenix Lord Voldemort voltou, mas o Ministério da Magia está a tentar esconder a verdade. É então que Ron e Hermione convencem Harry Potter a treinar secretamente um grupo restrito de alunos para a guerra que se avizinha. Prepara-te para a batalha!

programme.title: Taken 3 (2014)
programme.desc: O último capítulo da saga Taken, com cenas exclusivas! Bryan Mills é acusado de um assassinato que não cometeu. Numa perseguição, Mills usa toda a sua perícia para limpar o nome e proteger a filha.

programme.title: The Covenant (???)
programme.desc: Durante a guerra no Afeganistão, um intérprete local arrisca sua própria vida para carregar um sargento ferido por quilômetros de terreno extenuante.

programme.title: Ultimato (???)
programme.desc: Jason Bourne é um assassino profissional que, depois de perder a memória e a única pessoa que amava, não se deixa intimidar pelas rajadas de balas de uma nova geração de assassinos altamente treinados, que perseguem todos os seus movimentos.

programme.title: O Guarda-costas e o Assassino (???)
programme.desc: O maior assassino profissional do Mundo sai da sombra para testemunhar contra o antigo patrão. Para se defender, contrata o mais famoso guarda-costas e, juntos, têm de pôr de lado as diferenças para conseguirem chegar a tempo ao julgamento.

programme.title: Red Right Hand (???)
programme.desc: A Vingança Cash está tentando viver uma vida honesta e tranquila, mas quando Big Cat o força a voltar aos seus serviços, ele se mostra capaz de qualquer coisa para proteger a cidade e a única família que lhe resta.

programme.title: O Fiel Jardineiro (???)
programme.desc: Numa zona remota do Quénia, a ativista Tessa é brutalmente assassinada. O seu companheiro de viagem, um médico local, desapareceu. Tudo aponta para um crime passional. Justin, o marido de Tessa, embarca numa perigosa viagem para limpar o nome dela.

programme.title: Uma Noite em Miami... (???)
programme.desc: Um relato fictício de uma noite incrível em que os ícones Muhammad Ali, Malcolm X, Sam Cooke e Jim Brown se reuniram discutindo seus papéis no Movimento dos Direitos Civis e na agitação cultural dos anos 60.

programme.title: Air (2023)
programme.desc: A história da parceria revolucionária entre um então desconhecido Michael Jordan e a incipiente divisão de basquete da Nike, que revolucionou o mundo do desporto e da cultura com a marca Air Jordan.

programme.title: O Príncipe (???)
programme.desc: Quando a sua filha é raptada, um assassino já retirado é forçado a voltar ao ativo. Mas para salvá-la ele terá de enfrentar o seu antigo rival...

programme.title: Correio de Droga (???)
programme.desc: Earl Stone é um octogenário que se encontra falido e sozinho. Quando a sua empresa lhe propõe um trabalho que exige simplesmente conduzir, a tarefa parece simples. Mas, sem se aperceber, Earl é contratado por um cartel de droga mexicano...

programme.title: Taken (???)
programme.desc: A Vingança Bryan Mills está a ser perseguido pela família dos homens que matou, ao salvar a filha de uma rede de tráfico albanesa. Em Istambul, Bryan e a mulher são raptados e é a filha quem vai salvá-los.

programme.title: Máximo Risco (???)
programme.desc: Maximum Risk A investigação de Alain Moreau sobre a morte do seu irmão gémeo leva-o para as ruas de Nova Iorque e para os braços da 'cunhada'. Perseguido por assassinos russos e ex-agentes do FBI, Moreau bate-se, numa corrida contra o tempo, por desvendar o mistério da morte do seu irmão.

programme.title: Perseguição (???)
programme.desc: A futura ex-mulher de Will desaparece misteriosamente numa estação de serviço. Ele mergulha no submundo do crime da cidade enquanto foge das autoridades numa corrida contra o tempo para encontrá-la.

programme.title: Aqueles Que Me Desejam a Morte (???)
programme.desc: Traumatizada pelo fracasso da sua última missão, Hannah, uma bombeira especializada, cruza o seu caminho com o de um rapaz de 12 anos, testemunha de uma morte violenta que agora é perseguido pelos assassinos.

programme.title: Missão Impossível (???)
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt é o agente secreto sobre quem recai a suspeita da responsabilidade pelas mortes da sua equipa de espionagem. Mas Hunt está sempre um passo à frente dos perseguidores e cada vez mais perto de descobrir a verdade.

programme.title: Equipa de Assalto (???)
programme.desc: Andrew Briggman é um jovem soldado dos EUA na invasão do Afeganistão que assiste à morte de civis inocentes a mando de um líder sádico, o Sargento Deeks. Mas quando o soldado considera denunciar a situação é confrontado com um dilema moral...

programme.title: Bullet Train: Comboio Bala (???)
programme.desc: Ladybug é um assassino determinado em fazer calmamente o seu trabalho, depois de muitas missões correrem mal. Mas o destino reúne a bordo de um comboio de alta velocidade 5 assassinos mortais, que descobrem que as suas missões têm algo em comum.

programme.title: Os Nossos Dias
programme.desc: S2 E35 Santos entrega a Regina uma pasta que um cliente deixou ficar no carro e esta apercebe-se de que contém documentos de uma figura pública da RTP. Alice chega animada à empresa e Guilherme recebe-a com ternura. Susana vai ao escritório de Francisco e pergunta-lhe quando poderão voltar a estar juntos.

programme.title: Tal Pai, Tal Filho

programme.title: Passeio das Estrelas
programme.desc: Celebra-se a carreira de Júlio Isidro através das entrevistas incríveis realizadas pelo próprio ao longo de mais de 50 anos. Uma autêntica "viagem ao baú". Trazer para a frente as entrevistas de Júlio Isidro a grandes estrelas de calibre mundial (de Woody Allen a Gilberto Gil, por exemplo).

programme.title: Fenómeno
programme.desc: Santa da Ladeira · S1 E8 Na Ladeira do Pinheiro é possível assistir a práticas em que a penitência e a dor fazem sentido. Será um espaço para a realização de milagres? É possível. Será o palco de um gigantesco embuste? Não sabemos. O certo é que a Igreja Ortodoxa Polaca se afastou daquela que já foi considerada uma santa.

programme.title: Pessa à Peça
programme.desc: Estes 15 microprogramas, mostram o trabalho jornalístico de Fernando Pessa (1902-2002) e assinalam os 20 anos da sua morte, no mesmo ano em que se comemoram os 120 anos do seu nascimento.

O seu mundo fechado é abalado pela chegada de Karin Thimm, que a fascina de imediato. Desenvolve-se uma intensa relação amorosa entre Petra e Karin, que, contudo, não perdura. O filme explora as complexas dinâmicas de poder e submissão nestas relações femininas, num exercício brilhante de Fassbinder sobre o seu próprio texto teatral, adaptado para o cinema.

programme.title: O Preço Certo
programme.desc: Há mais de duas décadas em emissão contínua na RTP1, "O Preço Certo", é o gameshow de maior longevidade da televisão mundial. Estreado pela primeira vez em 1956 nos Estados Unidos, já foi transmitido em mais de 30 países. O sucesso por todo o mundo é testemunho da sua contínua popularidade e vitalidade, provando ser um clássico e intemporal formato de programas de entretenimento. Estreado em 2002 com o nome "O Preço Certo em Euros", para familiarizar os portugueses com a nova moeda, foi primeiro apresentado por Jorge Gabriel e depois por Fernando Mendes, sempre com Miguel Vital a dar voz aos fabulosos prémios. Em 2006 foi relançado com o nome original de O Preço Certo mantendo o apresentador e toda a boa disposição.

programme.desc: S1 E50 Agarra-me Se Puderes desafia concorrentes de todo o país a colocarem à prova os seus conhecimentos numa corrida contra o tempo pela conquista do prémio final. O concurso combina cultura geral e competição num formato divertido para toda a família, com o anfitrião José Pedro Vasconcelos.

programme.title: Portugal em Rede
programme.desc: O Portugal que existe para além das grandes cidades, do norte ao sul e às ilhas, numa verdadeira rede de informação. Inclui um segmento dedicado à língua portuguesa e à sua promoção "Esta língua que nos une". Os Centros de Informação Regional terão uma participação relevante neste espaço.

programme.title: O Preço Certo
programme.desc: Há mais de duas décadas em emissão contínua na RTP1, "O Preço Certo", é o gameshow de maior longevidade da televisão mundial. Estreado pela primeira vez em 1956 nos Estados Unidos, já foi transmitido em mais de 30 países. O sucesso por todo o mundo é testemunho da sua contínua popularidade e vitalidade, provando ser um clássico e intemporal formato de programas de entretenimento. Estreado em 2002 com o nome "O Preço Certo em Euros", para familiarizar os portugueses com a nova moeda, foi primeiro apresentado por Jorge Gabriel e depois por Fernando Mendes, sempre com Miguel Vital a dar voz aos fabulosos prémios. Em 2006 foi relançado com o nome original de O Preço Certo mantendo o apresentador e toda a boa disposição.

programme.title: Telejornal
programme.desc: A mais rigorosa seleção de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. De segunda a domingo, João Adelino Faria, José Rodrigues dos Santos, Cristina Esteves e Ana Lourenço mostram-lhe o que de mais relevante se passou o país e no mundo. Se é importante está no Telejornal.

programme.title: Joker
programme.desc: S12 E23 Vasco Palmeirim apresenta o JOKER, o concurso favorito dos portugueses. Um concorrente, com a ajuda de 7 Jokers e do Super Joker, responde a 12 perguntas com um só objetivo em mente: Conquistar os 50 000 euros do prémio máximo!

programme.title: Leonor, Marquesa de Alorna
programme.desc: S1 E2 Finalmente em liberdade, Leonor encontra obstáculos inesperados: o pai que não aceita um casamento com Carlos Augusto com o receio de voltar a afastar-se da filha. Fica também a saber de pormenores do passado do Conde que a deixam sobressaltada. Apesar de estar em liberdade, Leonor ainda se sente presa. Com a sua determinação e poder de persuasão, casa-se com Carlos Augusto e convence a Rainha de Portugal a abrir-lhe a porta para um novo mundo.

programme.desc: Hate Crime · S1 E6 Jude volta a introduzir-se num gangue de supremacistas brancos para travar um ataque de terrorismo interno, para isso arriscando a sua própria alma. A equipa apoia-o, sabendo que lhes poderá vir a custar tudo.

programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: A Man Possessed · S14 E8 Depois de um incêndio criminoso afetar alguém próximo ao Corpo de Bombeiros, Severide parte em busca do culpado. Enquanto isso, Mouch e Pascal buscam soluções inovadoras para enfrentar os cortes orçamentários iminentes.

programme.title: Blackkklansman
programme.desc: O Infiltrado Ron Stallworth é o primeiro detetive afro-americano da Polícia de Colorado Springs, mas a sua chegada é vista com ceticismo e alguma hostilidade... É então que Stallworth decide entrar numa perigosa missão: infiltrar-se e expor o Ku Klux Klan.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Força de Intervenção Alex Montell, um traficante de droga, é transportado pela Polícia de Los Angeles e mantido em custódia federal. Mas tudo se complica quando o prisioneiro oferece 100 milhões de dólares a quem o libertar.

programme.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles: New Generation
programme.desc: S1 E5 Molotov Cocktail Attire A equipa descobre um plano de assassinato durante uma gala política. Hondo começa a identificar a fonte das fugas internas quando os laços ocultos de Malik à Câmara Municipal vêm à superfície.

programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: S14 E7 Pierce the Vein Severide investiga um incêndio suspeito numa escola secundária. Novak recebe uma chamada inesperada. Violet tem um bombeiro a juntar-se a ela para um turno de ambulância.

programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: S13 E13 Born of Fire O antigo inimigo de Violet regressa, pedindo a sua ajuda. Herrmann cria um cocktail de assinatura para o Molly's.

programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: S13 E14 Bar Time Um visitante surpresa do passado de Novak junta-se a Ambo para uma viagem noturna. Herrmann enfrenta uma montanha de papelada. Violet apanha Carver numa mentira.

programme.title: Mentes Criminosas
programme.desc: S16 E6 Evolution: True Conviction As consequências da explosão ameaçam encerrar o caso Sicarius, a menos que a Unidade de Análise de Comportamento possa justificar um motivo para mantê-lo aberto. A investigação conduz a equipa a um prisioneiro no corredor da morte - mas será ele um assassino ou outra das vítimas de Sicarius?

programme.title: Mentes Criminosas
programme.desc: S16 E7 Evolution: What Doesn't Kill Us Com o destino da investigação de Sicarius em jogo, a Unidade de Análise de Comportamento aceita um caso na Virgínia Ocidental, onde um suspeito pratica a sua própria forma distorcida de vingança inspirada no Velho Testamento.

programme.title: The Rookie
programme.desc: S7 E15 A Deadly Secret Uma equipa que prepara um documentário entrevista a LAPD no caso complicado de uma pessoa desaparecida ligada a John.

programme.title: The Rookie
programme.desc: S7 E16 The Return A equipa tem sentimentos mistos quando um rosto familiar regressa com a esperança de provar aquilo que vale. Entretanto, um influenciador incita os seus fãs a irem atrás de Wesley, e o Tim apoia Lucy enquanto ela se prepara para o exame de sargento.

programme.title: The Rookie
programme.desc: S7 E17 Mutiny and the Bounty A equipa ajuda Skip Tracer Randy quando a sua nova paixão amorosa é raptada. Entretanto, Angela e Nyla convocam as mães para ajudar a apanhar um burlão e Wesley é ameaçado para desistir de um caso.

programme.title: The Rookie
programme.desc: S7 E18 The Good, the Bad, and the Oscar John e Harper trabalham juntos para apanhar Oscar; Angela investiga um assalto a um banco; Lucy e Tim aprendem a adaptar-se ao novo horário dela, e o primeiro encontro de Miles toma um rumo inesperado.

programme.title: The Rookie
programme.desc: S4 E1 Life and Death Nolan e a equipa apressam-se a localizar Lopez, depois de ela ser raptada no dia do seu casamento. O grupo não olha a meios para a salvar, bem como ao bebé ainda por nascer.

programme.title: The Rookie
programme.desc: S4 E2 Five Minutes Nolan e Chen recebem uma dica de um conhecido ladrão que os alerta para um possível assalto durante o grande evento Getty. Entretanto, Nolan ganha coragem para convidar Bailey para sair.

programme.title: O Comboio das 3 e 10
programme.desc: Dan Evans, um veterano da Guerra Civil que luta por manter o seu rancho e ganhar o respeito do filho, voluntaria-se para escoltar o perigoso Ben até ao comboio das 3h10, que o levará ao julgamento. Mas os homens de Ben vão fazer de tudo para o resgatar e, apesar de capturado, ele é uma ameaça letal.

programme.title: Como Despachar um Encalhado (???)
programme.desc: Trip nunca foi capaz de deixar o ninho. Ele sempre teve uma razão ou outra, mas agora, os seus pais desesperados estão fartos. Eles contratam a linda e talentosa rapariga dos seus sonhos para o fazer sair de casa.

programme.title: O Sorriso das Estrelas (???)
programme.desc: Numa estalagem, uma mãe de família que se encontra em processo de divórcio e um cirurgião que acaba de sofrer, também ele, um grande trauma, apaixonam-se.

programme.title: Sullivan's Crossing
programme.desc: Bad Timing · S3 E6 A neurocirurgiã Maggie Sullivan reencontra o seu passado rural, depois de um escândalo a obrigar a abandonar a sua vida na cidade.

programme.title: Sullivan's Crossing
programme.desc: Twists and Turns · S3 E7 A neurocirurgiã Maggie Sullivan reencontra o seu passado rural, depois de um escândalo a obrigar a abandonar a sua vida na cidade.

programme.title: As Cinquenta Sombras Livre (Unveiled Edition) (???)
programme.desc: Uma versão alargada do 3º capítulo baseado no fenómeno mundial de vendas 'Cinquenta Sombras', nunca antes vista nos cinemas. Christian e Anastasia casaram, mas assim que ela assume o papel de Sra. Grey, novas ameaças podem comprometer o final feliz.

programme.title: Prontas a Ajudar (???)
programme.desc: Nesta comédia sexual atrevida, quatro jovens chegam a Inglaterra para começarem os seus novos empregos como au pairs e depressa descobrem que passam mais tempo com a família que as acolhe, do que a cuidar das crianças.

programme.title: Al Berto (???)
programme.desc: Al Berto dá corpo a uma geração em mudança; cria um grupo de amigos que transpira juventude, excentricidade e sonhos de mudança, mas pouco tempo após a revolução, a cidade ainda não está preparada para tanta liberdade... liberdade para amar sem medo.

programme.title: A Vida Luminosa (???)
programme.desc: Primavera em Lisboa. Nicolau faz 24 anos e vive com os pais, preso ao sonho falhado de ser músico e à memória da ex-namorada. Ao descobrir a insatisfação da mãe, muda-se, arranja emprego e redescobre sonhos, rumo a novos amores e futuros.

programme.title: O Senhor dos Anéis: Os Anéis do Poder
programme.desc: Elven Kings Under the Sky · S2 E1 Sauron negocia com Adar. O Estranho e Nori aventuram-se em novas terras. Os três Anéis Élficos enfrentam o julgamento.

programme.title: Moon o Panda (???)
programme.desc: Tian tem 12 anos quando é enviado para casa da avó devido aos seus fracos resultados escolares. Longe da cidade, nas montanhas chinesas, torna-se amigo de um panda, a quem chama Moon. Este encontro inicia uma aventura incrível que mudará a sua vida.

programme.title: Homem-Cão (VP) (???)
programme.desc: Após um acidente, um polícia e o seu cão são fundidos num só, dando origem ao destemido Homem-Cão. Com instintos caninos e coração de herói, ele luta contra o vilão Petey, o Gato, enquanto tenta provar o seu valor.

programme.title: A Grande Viagem 3: Corrida à Volta do Mundo (VP) (???)
programme.desc: Depois de duas aventuras, o urso Mik-Mik só quer paz, mas uma cegonha troca novamente os bebés. Para corrigir o erro, Mik-Mik e os amigos atravessam continentes numa corrida pelo mundo para reunir o bebé perdido com a sua família.

programme.title: A Idade do Gelo 2: Descongelados (VP) (???)
programme.desc: Manny, Sid e Diego estão de volta! A Idade do Gelo acabou e os animais estão deliciados com um paraíso descongelado, cheio de parques de água e poços. Mas, quando descobrem que as milhas de gelo derretido poderão inundar o vale, têm de encontrar um caminho para escapar ao dilúvio que se aproxima.

programme.title: Pixels (2015)
programme.desc: Aliens intergalácticos interpretam imagens de videojogos clássicos como declarações de guerra e a Terra é atacada. Agora, cabe a um ex-campeão de jogos da década de 80 liderar uma equipa de jogadores da velha guarda, derrotar os aliens e salvar o planeta.

programme.title: Música e Letra (???)
programme.desc: Um antigo elemento de um popular grupo dos anos 1980 junta-se à palavrosa Sophie para comporem uma canção destinada a uma jovem estrela da pop.

programme.title: Amor sem Aviso (???)
programme.desc: Apesar de activista dos direitos humanos, uma advogada torna-se na assistente pessoal de um playboy milionário.

programme.title: Frankie e Johnny (1991)
programme.desc: Frankie trabalha num snack-bar e leva uma vida solitária até ao dia em que vem trabalhar para o mesmo local, Johnny, um cozinheiro acabado de sair da prisão.

programme.title: Stargirl (???)
programme.desc: Um estudante do ensino secundário, de aparência modesta, sente-se inexplicavelmente atraído pela nova aluna de espírito livre, cujos modos pouco convencionais mudam a forma como ambos se vêem a si próprios — e um ao outro.

programme.title: Encontro com o Amor (???)
programme.desc: Um homem e uma mulher que se conhecem acidentalmente, desenvolvem uma relação muito próxima.

programme.title: Curiosa (???)
programme.desc: Uma história de amor apaixonada que tem como pano de fundo a liberdade sexual, baseada vagamente na relação entre os autores do século XIX Pierre Louÿs e Marie de Régnier.

programme.title: Dulcineia (???)
programme.desc: Após 13 anos em Lisboa, Hugo, contrabaixista de jazz, volta ao Porto para reencontrar o equilíbrio familiar. Porém, sua paz desmorona ao ouvir Luís Stockman tocar um tema inédito ao piano, idêntico ao que Hugo compõe há anos na cabeça.

programme.title: Amor no Amazonas (???)
programme.desc: Una professora viaja ao Brasil e contrata um capitão de barco para entregarem uma carta urgente à sua irmã que vive no rio Amazonas. Durante a viagem, entre tempestades e encontros com animais exóticos, descobrem que o maior romance é o deles.

programme.title: Alguém como Eu (???)
programme.desc: Helena, uma jovem de 30 anos, toma a decisão de viver em Lisboa, ser solteira, independente e indisponível. Mas não controla o destino e dá de caras com o homem da sua vida. Entretanto pede a Deus um homem mais parecido consigo. Estará preparada?

programme.title: Uma Paixão no Niagara (???)
programme.desc: Depois de ser abandonada, Madeline viaja até às Cataratas do Niágara, para passar a lua de mel que devia ter partilhado com o noivo. Lá, reencontra-se com seu lado aventureiro, aprende a relaxar e tem uma oportunidade de recomeço.

programme.title: Amor Amor (???)
programme.desc: A história de um grupo de amigos que na passagem de ano vive todos os ziguezagues do amor. Há quem venha a descobrir-se a si próprio. Há quem venha a descobrir o amor. E há quem venha a conhecer o preço da liberdade.

programme.title: Looney Tunes: Daffy & Porky Salvam o Mundo (???)
programme.desc: Porky e Daffy descobrem um esquema alienígena de controlo mental via pastilha elástica e tornam-se improváveis heróis para salvar a Terra, enquanto lidam com as suas próprias trapalhadas e diferenças.

programme.title: Os Mauzões (???)
programme.desc: Após anos de assaltos e a ocuparem o topo da lista dos vilões mais procurados do mundo, um gangue de animais fora da lei é finalmente apanhado. É então que o Sr. Lobo faz um acordo para os salvar todos da prisão: Os Mauzões vão tornar-se...bonzinhos!

programme.title: Sketch: Cuidado com o Que Desenhas (???)
programme.desc: Uma menina descobre que os monstros violentos que desenha ganham vida quando o seu caderno cai num lago mágico. Agora, com a cidade em perigo, ela, o irmão e o pai terão de salvar todos — e enfrentar os seus próprios medos.

programme.title: A minha Namorada Tem Amnésia (???)
programme.desc: Adam Sandler no papel de um homem que se apaixona por uma jovem, Drew Barrymore, que sofre de amnésia. Depois do dia perfeito ela acorda para não se lembrar de nada do que se passou e não reconhece o homem que se apaixonou totalmente por ela.

programme.title: O Sorriso das Estrelas (???)

programme.title: Iguarias Semivegetarianas
